title: Member guide
intro: Everything about having an account with the club: how to sign up, what it gets you, how paying works and what the trial period is. Membership costs $5 per term and is open to MathSoc members only. Anyone can read this page, but you need an account to take part.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: Open the Account tab and sign in with your @uwaterloo.ca email. We email you a one-time code, so there's no password to remember. Membership is for MathSoc members only.

steps.title: Register for the term
steps.text: Fill in your name, year, program and work term status. Everything else (interests, co-ops, skills, contact details, exams) is optional and can be edited whenever you like. A new term means a new one-click renewal. Your details carry over.

steps.title: Pay $5 for the term
steps.text: Pay in cash at the club office or to an exec at an event, or pay through WUSA and enter the 6-digit confirmation number on your Account page. Details below.

steps.title: Use your membership
steps.text: Sign in to events on your phone or with the door QR code, join mentorship, resume critique and mock interviews, and request exam discount codes.

sections.title: Paying for your membership
paragraphs: Membership is $5 per term, for MathSoc members only. There are two ways to pay. Either way, an exec is the one who finally marks you as paid, and your Account page always shows where you're at.
bullets: Cash: pay at the club office or to an exec at an event. Your account shows Awaiting payment until they mark you as paid, which usually takes a moment.
WUSA: pay through WUSA, then enter the 6-digit confirmation number from your receipt under My membership. Your account shows Awaiting confirmation and your trial period starts right away.

sections.title: The WUSA trial period
paragraphs: WUSA payments can take a couple weeks to show up on the club's side, so you don't have to wait to take part. While your payment is awaiting confirmation you can sign in to events.
The trial doesn't unlock programs or discount codes. Those open up as soon as an exec confirms your payment.
bullets: The trial lasts two weeks from when you enter your number, and it can only be used once per term.
Every two weeks the club gets a list of payments from WUSA. Execs check your number against it. If it's there, you're marked paid and everything unlocks.

If we can't find your payment in WUSA's records, or the same confirmation number is on another account, your account is flagged and sign-in is paused until an exec sorts it out. Email the club or come to office hours to verify in person. This is usually a typo, so double-check the number you enter.
Want it confirmed sooner? Show an exec your WUSA receipt in person, or email the club a screenshot. They can mark you as paid straight away.

sections.title: What's on your account
paragraphs: Your Account page is where you manage everything about your membership.
bullets: Membership: this term's payment status and your history.
Events attended: a record of the events you signed in to.
Your details: first and last name, year, program, work term status and dietary restrictions. Execs use these for event planning and food orders.

Tell us more: interests, actuarial co-ops, skills, contact details, credentials and exams. This is optional and is shown in the member directory, which only signed-in members can see. You can switch the directory off any time.
Programs: your mentorship, resume critique and mock interview sign-ups, plus exam discount codes for paid members.

sections.title: Exam discount codes
paragraphs: Paid members can get discount codes for exam study materials. Open Programs under your account and press Request next to the code you want. The code shows up right away, and the club keeps a record of who asked for each one. Please don't share codes.

sections.title: Who sees what
bullets: Other members only see what you add under Tell us more, and only if the directory switch is on.
Execs can see your registration details and your attendance. Only execs see payment details.
Accounts from old terms are cleared out periodically. You can also ask the club to delete your account from your Account page.

faq.q: I paid by WUSA but forgot to enter the number. What now?
faq.a: Enter it on your Account page any time. If you've already shown an exec your receipt, you don't need to.
Email the club with your receipt and an exec will fix it. Your trial can only be started once per term, so please check the number before you submit it.
An exec needs to double check your payment. Show an exec your receipt or email a screenshot and they'll sort it out.

faq.q: Can I use the site without an account?
faq.a: Yes. Events, resources, programs and the exec team are public. You need a @uwaterloo.ca account to sign in to events or use member programs.
Membership is $5 per term and is open to MathSoc members only.
